description: This source file implements the Messenger plugin for a WPEFramework-based application. It includes methods for initializing, deinitializing, joining/leaving chat rooms, sending messages, subscribing to updates, and handling remote connection deactivation. The code interacts with the framework's plugin infrastructure, managing room objects, callbacks, and connection lifecycle.

classes.name: Plugin::Messenger
classes.description: The Messenger class manages chat room interactions, message dispatching, subscription to updates, and connection handling within the plugin framework.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Messenger plugin, establishing required components and resources.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Releases resources and cleans up state upon plugin deinitialization.

methods.name: JoinRoom
methods.description: Joins a chat room with specified room and user names, creating a notification sink.

methods.name: SubscribeUserUpdate
methods.description: Subscribes or unsubscribes to user updates within a specific room.

methods.name: LeaveRoom
methods.description: Leaves the specified chat room, releasing associated resources.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to the specified chat room.

methods.name: GenerateRoomId
methods.description: Generates a unique room ID based on room name, user name, and current timestamp using SHA1 hash.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Handles remote connection deactivation events (conditional compilation for R4).
